english.title: Place / leave vehicle / bicycle / conveyance in a manner to cause obstruction
english.standardoffencewording:
On **(..SPECIFY DATE..) at **(..SPECIFY LOCATION..) was in charge of a

(A)_[motor vehicle, namely **(..SPECIFY VEHICLE MAKE AND REGISTRATION NUMBER..),]_
(B)_[bicycle,]_
(C)_[conveyance, namely **(..SPECIFY THE CONVEYANCE..),]_

and left or placed it on part of the Merseyrail railway,

(D)_[in such a manner or place as to cause an obstruction or hindrance to the operator or person using the railway]_
(E)_[otherwise in accordance with instructions issued by or on behalf of the railway operator, namely **(..SPECIFY THE INSTRUCTIONS..)]_
english.legislation: Contrary to byelaws 14(2) and 24(1) of the Merseyrail Railway Byelaws 2014.
english.pointstoprove:
date and location
while in charge of a motor vehicle/bicycle/conveyance
left/placed it on part of the Merseyrail railway
in such a manner/place as to cause an obstruction
or otherwise than in accordance with instructions issued by the railway operator
